method: Read all four installer/package template files through EOF; pinned Git blob identity verified. No installer executed.
findings: Installer uses per-user lowest privileges and selects x86/x64/ARM64 package. Runtime detection searches PATH dotnet output for WindowsDesktop.App 9.0 without an explicit architecture check.

Silent mode falls back to net481 when net9 is absent; interactive runtime download/install failures also fall back. No explicit net481 availability check appears here. Runtime installer accepts only exit zero and rechecks detection.
Runtime download uses fixed 9.0.3 URLs with empty expected checksum argument. This script does not independently establish downloaded runtime integrity.

InstallDelete and UninstallDelete recursively remove all app-directory contents, including user-added content. Startup Run value is unquoted; archive extraction embeds installation path in a PowerShell single-quoted literal without escaping apostrophes.

Chocolatey install passes SHA256 to its package helper, refining prior builder observation: installation checks the generated digest, while generation trusts the release download. Unsupported Windows build only warns.
Interactive parameter string false is recognized; a boolean false still enables interactive mode by presence.

Uninstaller selects display-name prefix across three registry locations without exact product ID or single-match admission. Removing every quote from UninstallString does not parse arguments; multiple matching entries can produce an array instead of a single executable path.
Nuspec links mutable master resources. Description CDATA and plain metadata depend on caller escaping, absent in reviewed builder.
limits: Static source evidence only, no Windows installer/runtime execution or package-helper implementation review.
Full repository count remains 148/500; ExplorerTabUtility partial 52/104. Native pHash memory-error investigation remains deferred.
